name: Ground Pork
siboNotes: Plain ground pork is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Choose lean varieties to minimize digestive stress during SIBO treatment.
preparationTips: Cook thoroughly to 160°F internal temperature for food safety
Drain excess fat after cooking to improve digestibility
Season with low-FODMAP herbs like oregano, basil, or thyme
Avoid pre-seasoned varieties that may contain garlic or onion powder
nutritionalHighlights: High in complete protein (20-25g per serving)
Rich in B vitamins, especially B12 and thiamine
Good source of zinc and selenium
Contains iron for healthy blood cells
